task.title: Reuse the verification dialog to authorize recovery from an account row
task.input: Existing UsersAdmin, M3-T12 ReauthDialog, and M3-T4 target-authorization API.
task.output: Target-row authorization controls and a one-time permit result on /admin/users; removal of the old direct-reset call.
task.accept: 1) Entry: admin Account permissions (admin-users-link) -> /admin/users -> an actual other-user row's Authorize recovery (user-authorize-recovery-{id}). Data sources: the existing user list, POST /api/admin/account/reauth, and POST /api/admin/account/recovery-authorizations. Reuse the completed dialog; a click actually sends target-grant and permit requests in order. Target factors stay unchanged, token displays once, and audit has actor/source/target (E-13). 2) The self row has no authorization control. Direct self/EDITOR/SALES/old-bodyless-reset requests reject. Cancellation sends no request; an unknown result does not reissue. Closing the result clears secrets; existing user creation/deletion/role contracts stay intact (E-73). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
